product: Custom trace views in the MLflow trace explorer are in Beta
tagline: You can now build custom trace views in the Databricks MLflow trace explorer.
what_it_does: You can now build custom trace views in the Databricks MLflow trace explorer. Describe the layout you want in plain language, and Genie generates a reusable view that surfaces the trace fields, metrics, and feedback controls most relevant to your review workflow. note This feature is in Beta.
why_it_matters: Display components When you describe a layout, Genie assembles it from a set of display components: Stat card: Displays a single metric or value, such as latency, token count, or a computed score.
